# Boss Outer Diameter

Screw boss outer diameter compared with its hole.

<figure markdown="span">
![Boss Outer Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-boss-od-ratio-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Boss Outer Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-boss-od-ratio-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Screw boss outer diameter against its hole diameter; a slim boss splits as the screw goes in.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 2.0× hole diameter | 1.8× hole diameter | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Slim Screw Boss (`{measured}` its hole): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}` its hole diameter. A thin boss wall is stretched hard by the screw. Make the boss larger for the hole.
!!! failure "Error"

    Screw Boss Too Slim (`{measured}` its hole): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}` its hole diameter. The screw will split the boss as it goes in, or strip it under load. Make the outer diameter at least `{target}` the hole diameter, and support the boss with ribs or gussets rather than a thicker wall.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
